mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 70 degrees.

City offices will be closed November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, impacting recycling schedules, and the city is currently evaluating plans to expand the Public Works and Utilities facility to support our growing population.
We have a busy weekend ahead, including live music today at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, plus live music tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy incident from November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver passed out; the woman was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough, and you still have time to head over before the store closes at 10:30 PM tonight.
